## HERA — Step 3 (plan): Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n −1.2 → +3.2×10¹², B 0.5 → 10 T

> **05:26** · landau-fan @ D=0: n -1.2 -> +3.2e12 fast (111 pts, dn 0.04, co-swept TG/BG); B 0.5 -> 10 T slow (50 mT, 191 rows); sr1 100 uV; delays 1.0/3.0 s; leak trip 1 nA · **ETA ~14:26** (≈9h)

**Why (plan step 3, operator-requested):** runs 6–7 established multi-band SdH on both carrier signs (run 6: high-B F ≈ 33.3 T ≈ F_full(4-fold); run 7: F ≈ 20 T > F_full = 12.4 T ⇒ compensated pockets), but single traces can't separate harmonics from independent bands. The fan's F(n) branch slopes and LL filling sequence are the stacking discriminant: ABAB → two bilayer-like branches sharing n with crossings; ABCA → one heavy branch at F_full; ABCB → Dirac + heavy mix.

**Design.** Fast axis: n from −1.2 to +3.2×10¹² cm⁻² (the full gate-box span along D = 0, both signs), Δn = 0.04×10¹² → 111 pts — resolves individual 4-fold LL lines down to B ≈ 0.5 T (Δn_4-fold = 4eB/h = 0.048×10¹² at 0.5 T). Co-swept (Vtg, Vbg) along the run-5-calibrated D = 0 line (endpoints (−0.277, −0.465) and (+0.984, +1.166) V — inside the box, validators backstop). Slow axis: B 0.5 → 10 T ascending (magnet sits at 0; onsets 0.3–0.7 T say nothing below 0.5 T at this Δn), 50 mT → 191 rows. sr1 sensitivity **100 µV = 10 kΩ FS** (run-5-proven for the full gate window at B = 0). **Stated trade:** the ν = 0 / gapped-CNP stripe may rail 10 kΩ at high B — accepted; rail positions still read, and the stacking evidence lives in the off-CNP branches. Dwells per run-5 calibration: fast_delay 1.0 s (≈3.3τ at τ = 0.3 s), slow_delay 3.0 s. Leak guard trips at 1 nA on either Keithley.

**Price:** measurement 191 × 111 × 1.17 s/pt (run-5 calibration incl. dwell) = 6.9 h; B ramps 9.5 T ≈ 69 min + initial 0.5 T ≈ 4 min; flybacks 191 × ~4 s ≈ 13 min; slow_delays ≈ 10 min → 8.6 h, headline **≈ 9 h** (session lesson: actuals run 5–10 % over).

**Checkpoints (hera-watch armed, `--next --follow`):** first 2–3 rows — rail/leak/dead channel/wrong sensitivity → abort; then ~hourly digest reads; interim fan re-forms at ~3 T and ~6 T (continue / adjust / abandon, priced at each). **End state:** B = 10 T, gates at the n = +3.2×10¹² point — no park; the post-fan step decides whether to ride the field down through another measurement.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): fast n = -1.2 -> +3.2e12 (co-swept TG/BG, 111 pts), slow B = 0.5 -> 10 T (50 mT, 191 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.round(np.arange(-1.2, 3.2 + 1e-9, 0.04), 3)          # 1e12 cm^-2, 111 pts
_VV = np.array([calc_gate_voltages(n, 0.0, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"]) for n in n_vec])
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = _VV[:, 0], _VV[:, 1]
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_vec.min() and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert BG_MIN <= Vbg_vec.min() and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.5, 10.0001, 0.05), 3)              # 191 rows ascending
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f"fan: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts) along D = 0; "
      f"(Vtg, Vbg) ({Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}, {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}) -> ({Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f}) V; "
      f"B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {len(B_vec)} rows; {len(n_vec)*len(B_vec)} pts total")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts with the 0.5 T ramp), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA (run-5-proven over the full
# gate window; stated trade — the gapped-CNP/nu=0 stripe may rail at high B, positions still read).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
I_TRIP = 1e-9
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), tau {sr1.time_constant()} s; "
      f"fast_delay 1.0 s (~3.3 tau), slow_delay 3.0 s; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan @ D=0 (run-5 cal): n -1.2 -> +3.2e12 fast (111 pts, dn 0.04, co-swept TG/BG), "
                  "B 0.5 -> 10 T slow (50 mT, 191 rows), sr1 100 uV, fast_delay 1.0, slow_delay 3.0")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 (111 pts, dn 0.04) co-swept '
              f'(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}, {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}) -> ({Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f}, {Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f}) V; '
              f'B 0.5 -> 10 T, 50 mT, ascending; cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, '
              f'n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
